paragraphs.text: Pramikon , also known as the Sky Rampart , is a mysterious wall on an unknown plane perpetually shrouded in mist. It is the only known Legendary Wall.

Pramikon rises from the surface of an ocean and seems to have no end, stretching off for miles in either direction. Anyone who approaches it finds themselves suddenly veering off towards unexpected destinations, as though an unseen hand is determined to steer them away.
